description.la: Compendium theologiae a Bonaventura circa annum 1257 conscriptum: prologus de sacra Scriptura et septem partes de Trinitate, creatura mundi, corruptela peccati, incarnatione Verbi, gratia Spiritus sancti, medicina sacramentali et statu finalis iudicii. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Tria opuscula, ed. 3, 1911), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A compendium of theology written about 1257: a prologue on Scripture and seven parts on the Trinity, the creation of the world, the corruption of sin, the incarnation of the Word, the grace of the Holy Spirit, the sacramental remedy and the state of the final judgment. The Latin is the Quaracchi text (Tria opuscula, 3rd ed., 1911), from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Compêndio de teologia escrito por volta de 1257: um prólogo sobre a Escritura e sete partes sobre a Trindade, a criação do mundo, a corrupção do pecado, a encarnação do Verbo, a graça do Espírito Santo, o remédio sacramental e o estado do juízo final.

sources.edition: Tria opuscula Seraphici Doctoris S. Bonaventurae: Breviloquium, Itinerarium mentis in Deum, De reductione artium ad theologiam, ed. 3 (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1911).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR of the octavo edition. Page heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings and cross-references) and note markers are removed; line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by comparison with the other Quaracchi scans. Where the scan lost a chapter heading the chapters run together under one title (Pars IV 4-5, Pars V 2, 4-6 and 8, 10).
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1911 is public domain.
